title: NC-FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-14-t518: Add pre-deploy D1 schema migration dry-run check to CI to prevent failed verified deploys
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-14-t518 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-14-t518
**Status:** closed

Add pre-deploy D1 schema migration dry-run check to CI to prevent failed verified deploys

Backlog done check: CI job 'd1-migrate-dry-run' runs `wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local` against a copy of prod schema on every PR; a PR with a breaking/failed migration is blocked from merge, demonstrated by a seeded failing test PR.

Triage: Requires adding a CI workflow/job (code/config change) and a seeded test PR; the in-Worker doer cannot edit code or trigger CI. | first step: Queue an engineering task to add the 'd1-migrate-dry-run' job to CI workflow running wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local on PRs, plus a seeded fai

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
